job.title: Systems Engineer
job.description:
Systems Engineer
 
Work on highly complex communications and network-based technology used within mission-critical environments worldwide.

This is an opportunity for a Systems Engineer to join a business developing advanced RF and integrated systems where reliability, performance, and technical quality are paramount.
 
As a Systems Engineer, you will play a key role in the development of advanced communications and network-based systems within a highly technical engineering environment. Working across the full product lifecycle, you will help design, develop, and verify integrated system solutions that support critical aviation infrastructure globally.
 
This role would suit an experienced Systems Engineer with a strong background in RF systems, radio communications, networking technologies, and systems integration. You will be joining a collaborative multidisciplinary team where technical thinking, problem solving, and engineering quality are genuinely valued.
 
Job Responsibilities
 
  • Contribute to the full product development lifecycle from requirements capture through to verification and delivery
  • Define and document system level requirements and functional specifications
  • Break down high-level customer and technical requirements into detailed functional use cases

  • Conduct technical design reviews and provide engineering input throughout development phases
  • Work on integrated system solutions involving radio communications, IP networking, VoIP, and associated technologies
  • Ensure systems comply with relevant industry standards, regulations, and technical requirements
  • Produce detailed technical documentation including system diagrams, configurations, and operational procedures
  • Support verification, validation, and integration activities across hardware and software environments
  • Identify technical risks and support resolution activities throughout projects
  • Contribute to system commonality and compatibility across product ranges
  • Support future product and technology planning activities
  • Provide technical guidance and coaching to junior engineers
  • Work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams across systems, software, hardware, and product functions
 
 
Skills and Experience
 
Essential
  • Previous experience working as a Systems Engineer, Senior Systems Engineer, or within a similar systems-focused engineering role
  • Degree qualified in a relevant engineering or technical discipline
  • Strong background in radio communications, RF systems, or related communications technologies
  • Good understanding of IP networking technologies
  • Experience working with VoIP systems and network-based communications
  • Strong understanding of the full product development lifecycle
  • Ability to translate requirements into functional system behaviours and use cases
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Experience producing technical system documentation
  • Understanding of systems integration and verification activities
  • Eligibility to obtain and maintain BPSS security clearance
 
Beneficial
  • Experience with cyber security measures or cyber resilience would be highly beneficial
  • Exposure to hardware design and/or software engineering would be advantageous
  • Knowledge of wider network technologies would be beneficial
 
Pay and Benefits
 
  • Salary up to £55,000
  • 37.5-hour working week with flexitime and core hours between 09:30–15:00
  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
  • Enhanced pension scheme with up to 8% company contribution

  • Long service and retirement awards
  • Subsidised staff canteen
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • Flu vaccinations
  • Continuous training and learning opportunities
  • Employee Assistance Programme and wellbeing support

If you are a Systems Engineer looking for a role where you can work on genuinely complex technology with real-world global impact, this opportunity offers the chance to be part of a highly respected engineering environment with long-term career development and technically challenging projects. Our client is looking to recruit an experienced Vehicle Fitter to join their busy manufacturing facility near Peterborough. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a strong mechanical engineering background combined with automotive electrical experience who enjoys a varied, hands-on role. You’ll be involved in both the manufacture of new electric vehicles and the maintenance and repair of an established rental fleet. With vehicles supplied into industries ranging from airports and automotive manufacturing to hospitals, power stations and specialist industrial environments, no two days are necessarily the same.

The Role
  • Building electric vehicles in accordance with job cards and production specifications
  • Mechanical fitting and assembly of vehicle components
  • Working with 12V and 48V automotive electrical systems
  • Electrical fault finding, diagnosis and repair
  • Preparing, servicing and repairing rental fleet vehicles
  • Working towards production build targets
  • Identifying opportunities to improve build times and product quality
  • Participating in ongoing technical and on-the-job training
  • Maintaining a clean, organised and safe working environment
  • Supporting the company's 5S and continuous improvement programmes
  • Following all Health & Safety procedures
What We're Looking For
  • A minimum of 2 years' mechanical engineering experience
  • A minimum of 2 years' experience working with automotive 12V and/or 48V electrical circuits
  • Experience of electrical fault finding, repair and general maintenance
  • A background within automotive, vehicle maintenance, manufacturing, aviation, power generation or a similar engineering environment
  • Good practical mechanical fitting skills
  • The ability to understand and communicate technical issues clearly
  • A flexible approach and the ability to prioritise work in a changing production environment
  • The ability to work independently as well as part of a team
  • A full clean driving licence

Welding experience would be a distinct advantage but is not essential. Specialist air tools required for the position will be provided.Above all, we're looking for someone with a positive "can-do" attitude who is happy to roll their sleeves up and get involved.

What's On Offer?
  • OTE £36,000–£48,000
  • 39-hour basic working week
  • Regular overtime opportunities
  • Company profit-share bonus scheme after qualifying service
  • 29 days' holiday including Bank Holidays

  • Genuine opportunities for progression

This position could be particularly suited to an experienced Vehicle Fitter, Auto Electrician, Electro-Mechanical Technician, Mechanical Fitter or Vehicle Technician looking for a varied engineering role away from a traditional garage environment.Interested? Apply today with an up-to-date CV for further information and immediate consideration.

job.title: Procurement & Operations Coordinator
job.description:
Procurement & Operations Coordinator
 
A hands-on role at the heart of a growing logistics business, coordinating purchasing, freight and commercial support.
 
This is a newly created Procurement & Operations Coordinator role, based in Gosport.
 
As a Procurement & Operations Coordinator you will support the commercial running of a growing logistics business, helping bring structure and consistency to how it buys, spends and works with suppliers. It is a varied, hands-on role covering three areas: purchasing coordination, freight supplier management, and commercial analysis. You will help pull purchasing together across the business, manage day-to-day relationships with a small group of freight providers, and turn spend data into useful commercial insight. With no formal purchasing system in place yet, there is a real chance to help shape how things are done and put proper processes in place. If you are organised, commercially curious and happy to roll your sleeves up, this newly created role gives you plenty to get involved in.
 
Job Responsibilities
  • Coordinating purchasing activity across the business and helping move away from each site buying independently
  • Supporting the setup of a purchase requisition and order process where none currently exists
  • Raising, processing and receiving purchase orders and dealing with suppliers day to day
  • Managing supplier relationships, particularly for high-volume purchasing
  • Supporting contract negotiations with suppliers
  • Managing relationships with a small group of freight providers
  • Reviewing freight charges, service levels and yearly price increases, and supporting negotiations
  • Analysing spend on freight and purchasing to support better commercial decisions
  • Reviewing profitability and turning data into clear commercial insight
  • Producing reporting to support the finance and commercial teams
 
Skills and Experience
To do well as a Procurement & Operations Coordinator you will need:
  • Some experience in a purchasing, procurement, freight or commercial support role
  • A commercially minded approach, with a good head for numbers and spend analysis
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to bring structure where there is little
  • Confidence dealing with suppliers and supporting negotiations
  • Good Excel skills and confidence working with data
  • Plenty of initiative and the drive to improve how things are done
  • Experience setting up or working with a purchase order or requisition system, which is desirable
  • Exposure to implementing new systems across purchase ordering or finance processes, which would be a real advantage
  • Logistics, transport or freight experience, which is desirable
 
Pay and Benefits
  • A salary of up to £40,000, dependent on experience
  • A 40-hour working week, Monday to Friday, with flexibility on start and finish times
  • Hybrid working available after successful completion of probation
  • An office-based role in Gosport, alongside the finance team
  • A newly created role with real scope to shape it and put your own processes in place
 
Ready to apply?
Newly created roles are a rare chance to make a job your own, and this one puts you right at the centre of how a growing business buys, spends and works with its suppliers. You would bring order where there is little, build processes from scratch and see the commercial impact of your work. If you are an organised, commercially minded Procurement & Operations Coordinator ready to get stuck in, apply now.

 We are looking to recruit a Electronic Test Engineer Engineer to join the team on a permanent contract, reporting to the Manufacturing Supervisor.   • Accurately record productive and non-productive hours on our ERP system

  • Good communication skills
  • Confident to ask questions

job.title: Toolmaker
job.description:
Toolmaker – Manual or CNC Peterborough | £16.00–£20.00 per hour | Permanent | Day shift | Overtime available

An established specialist engineering company in Peterborough is looking to appoint an experienced Toolmaker to join its skilled manufacturing team. Applications are welcomed from candidates with either manual or CNC machining experience. You do not need to have experience across every type of machinery; the position can be tailored to make the best use of your existing skills.

The role
Working from engineering drawings and customer specifications, you will manufacture, modify, repair and maintain precision tooling and engineered components. Depending on your experience, your responsibilities may include:
  • Manufacturing precision tools, moulds, fixtures and components.
  • Operating manual or CNC milling, turning and other machine tools.
  • Producing one-off and small-batch components to tight tolerances.
  • Carrying out tooling modifications, repairs and refurbishment work.
  • Setting and operating machinery safely and efficiently.
  • Reading and interpreting detailed engineering drawings.
  • Inspecting completed components using precision measuring equipment.
  • Identifying and resolving machining, tooling and dimensional issues.
  • Working closely with design, manufacturing and assembly colleagues.
  • Ensuring completed work meets the required quality and delivery standards.
  • Maintaining a safe, clean and organised working environment.
The position offers varied engineering work rather than repetitive, high-volume production.

We are interested in hearing from experienced Toolmakers with either manual or CNC machining skills. You should have:
  • Previous experience as a Toolmaker, Precision Machinist or similarly skilled engineer.
  • Strong manual or CNC machining skills.
  • The ability to work accurately from engineering drawings.
  • Experience producing components to close tolerances.
  • A good understanding of engineering materials, machining methods and workshop practices.
  • Confidence using precision measuring and inspection equipment.

job.title: System Test Engineer
job.description:
System Test Engineer Market Deeping | Circa £40,000 per annum | Permanent

We are recruiting a System Test Engineer to join an established technology manufacturer based in Market Deeping. The company designs and manufactures specialist electronic communication systems used in safety-critical environments worldwide. You will be responsible for integrating, configuring and testing complex customer systems, ensuring that each system meets its technical and contractual requirements before Factory Acceptance Testing and delivery.

The role

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Integrating, configuring and testing customer communication systems.
  • Conducting Factory Acceptance Tests and responding to technical queries from customers.
  • Preparing and maintaining FAT documentation, test reports and technical records.
  • Configuring and testing system cabinets, databases and third-party equipment.
  • Working closely with Engineering, Production, Purchasing, Planning and other departments to ensure systems are ready for testing and delivery.
  • Identifying, investigating and recording technical faults.
  • Coordinating with relevant teams to drive faults and technical issues through to resolution.
  • Monitoring system-readiness risks and communicating potential effects on project milestones.
  • Carrying out electrical and safety testing on equipment and system cabinets.
  • Supporting order fulfilment activities, including kit marshalling and inventory audits.
  • Ensuring technical documentation and customer handbooks are accurate and up to date.
  • Managing your workload effectively to meet customer deadlines and project milestones.
  • Supporting continuous improvements to testing processes and system quality.
What we are looking for:
  • A-Levels in Maths and a Science subject, an HNC in Electrical or Electronic Engineering, or a comparable technical qualification.
  • Experience testing electronic communication systems.
  • Knowledge or experience of VHF and UHF radio communication equipment, ideally involving ground-to-air systems.
  • Experience integrating, configuring or fault-finding complex electronic systems.
  • The ability to interpret technical specifications, drawings and test documentation.
  • Good IT skills, particularly with Microsoft Office.
  • A methodical approach to testing, fault diagnosis and technical record keeping.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • The confidence to communicate directly with customers during Factory Acceptance Testing.
  • A proactive, customer-focused and flexible approach.
  • The ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively across several departments.
Security and screening requirements

Due to the nature of the products and customers involved, the successful candidate must be able to obtain and maintain Baseline Personnel Security Standard clearance. Applicants must be able to provide a complete and checkable five-year history covering employment, education and any periods when they were not working or studying. Any offer of employment will be subject to the successful completion of the required security and pre-employment checks.

Benefits
  • 37.5-hour working week.
  • Flexible working hours, with core hours between 9:30am and 3:00pm.
  • 25 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays.
  • Pension scheme with up to 8% company contribution.
  • Private healthcare.
  • Life assurance.
  • Up to three “Liberty Days”, allowing annual leave to be requested on the day.
  • Option to buy or sell holiday.
  • Training and continuous learning opportunities.
  • Long-service and retirement awards.
  • Employee Assistance Programme and wellbeing services.
  • Flu vaccinations.
  • Subsidised staff canteen.
  • Cycle-to-work scheme.
  • Free onsite parking.
This is an excellent opportunity to join a specialist engineering business and take responsibility for testing complex communication systems used in safety-critical applications. Apply today for immediate consideration.
